name: L’accueil et le service · Welcome and Service
situation: The team welcomes arriving adult diners and settles the bill at a curved reception desk.

name: La salle du dîner · Dinner Room
situation: Adult diners choose their meal while the team lays a round table and brings the first course.

name: Le salon du banquet · Banquet Salon
situation: An adult restaurant owner and his team prepare a small cabaret supper around a long curved banquet table.

name: La cave et le conditionnement · Cellar and Bottling
situation: An adult cellar team prepares sealed bottles and checks the corking tools below the restaurant.

name: Le terroir et les arômes · Origins and Aromas
situation: Adult staff explain vineyard origins and food aromas at a daylight cellar workshop, with no drinking.

name: La réserve de la brasserie · Brasserie Stores
situation: Two adult staff check a restaurant’s locked drinks and tobacco stock, with every bottle sealed and nobody drinking or smoking.

name: Le laboratoire du calcul · Calculation Workshop
situation: An adult tutor and a red-beret mime prepare three identical activity kits while learners check totals and averages.

name: Les formes et les repères · Shapes and Reference Points
situation: Adult learners build a triangular model and check its angle, formula, interval and reference-book rating.
